subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned requireMention group messages for later mentioned turns, and what bounded privacy/retention policy should govern that media?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix changes what unmentioned group attachments are downloaded, retained, and exposed to later prompts; that is a channel privacy/security boundary rather than a safe autonomous repair choice.

options.title: Approve bounded image retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages under existing group authorization and context visibility rules, with prompt text showing counts/context but not host paths.

options.title: Keep unmentioned media text-only
options.body: Treat unmentioned Telegram group media as intentionally unavailable to later turns and document that the group-history window stores only text placeholders for this case.

options.title: Require live design proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer-reviewed live Telegram proof demonstrates the failure and validates the proposed retention behavior with privacy limits.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded image retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages under existing group authorization and context visibility rules, with prompt text showing counts/context but not host paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram group-history and context-selection commits make this the closest current owner signal for the channel policy boundary.
